question: Who among the following is the Chairman of Planning Commission and National Integration Council of India?
solution:
The correct answer is **__The Prime Minister.__**

The Chairman of the Planning Commission and National Integration Council of India is t**he Prime Minister**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **National Integration Council **was established in the year** 1961**.

 
 
• Its** first meeting took place in 1962**.
 
• The **National Integration Council was established by the then Prime Minister Jawaharlal Nehru to address the problems of communalism and regionalism in India.**
 
• **The Prime Minister is the chairman of the council.**
 
• The National Integration Council is an **extra-constitutional body**.
 
• The** function of the council is to examine the problem of national integration in every aspect and make necessary recommendations to deal with it**
 
• **Information about the National Integration Council.**
 
 
 
• Planning Commission
 
 
• It was an institution in the** Government of India.**
 
• It formulated **five-year plans.**
 
• It was formed on 15 March 1950.
 
• It was dissolved on 17 August 2014 and replaced by the new institution **NITI Aayog.**
 
• **The Prime Minister** of India was the ex-officio chairman of the Planning Commission.
